name: instacertify-crm
description: Standalone Instacertify CRM (Next.js + NestJS + PostgreSQL) — certification consulting & testing sales. No ERPNext.

scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
scripts.build: npm run generate -w @instacertify/database && npm run build -w @instacertify/api && npm run build -w @instacertify/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @instacertify/api --if-present && npm run lint -w @instacertify/web --if-present
